admin.help_gemini_title: Getting a Google Gemini API key
help_gemini_steps: Sign in to Google AI Studio (aistudio.google.com/apikey) with a Google account.
Press 'Create API key' and pick a project (one is made if you have none).
Copy the key, paste it into 'API key' above and save.
After saving, 'Image model' lists the image models this key can use.
admin.help_gemini_note: Image generation is billed (about $0.05 per banner). If image models are blocked on the free tier, link billing in AI Studio.
help_openai_steps: Sign in to the OpenAI Platform (platform.openai.com/api-keys).
Press 'Create new secret key' and give it a name.
The key is shown only once: copy it now, paste it into 'API key' above and save.
Add a payment method or credits under Settings → Billing.
admin.help_openai_note: gpt-image models may need a verified organization (Settings → Organization → Verify). Check this if the model list is empty.
admin.help_youtube_title: Getting a YouTube Data API key
help_youtube_steps: Sign in to the Google Cloud console (console.cloud.google.com) and create or pick a project.
Under 'APIs & Services → Library', find 'YouTube Data API v3' and press 'Enable'.
Create a key under 'APIs & Services → Credentials → Create credentials → API key'.
Open the key and restrict it: API restriction 'YouTube Data API v3' only; application restriction 'None' or 'IP addresses' (the NAS's public IP).
Copy the key, paste it into 'API key' below and save.
admin.help_youtube_note: Don't use the 'HTTP referrers (websites)' restriction: the server does the searching, so such a key is refused. The free quota is 10,000 units a day and a search costs 100.
admin.photosDesc: An artist.jpg in an artist's folder (the parent of the album folders) is used at each scan. Otherwise the photo of the musician's Wikipedia article (Korean, then English) is fetched. Change or remove a photo on the artist's page.
